written.headline: IndiaAI Mission unveils three indigenous AI foundation models
written.summary: The IndiaAI Mission released three domestically developed foundation models—EKA‑1 by Soket AI Labs and Dhīr 2B and Dhīr 5B by ZenteiQ AiTech Innovations—at a New Delhi event on Nov 3. EKA‑1 is a 26.3‑billion‑parameter model supporting 22 Indian languages, while the Dhīr models are open‑source multilingual assistants designed for on‑premise and offline use.

written.headline: Anthropic open-sources FlashProve for provable inference on Llama 4 Maverick
written.summary: Anthropic released an open‑source prototype called FlashProve that can cryptographically prove a response came from a specified model. On a single H100 GPU it generates proofs for the 400‑billion‑parameter Llama 4 Maverick at about 110 tokens per second, with proof files around 19 MB per 1,024‑token request.
